claim.description: Falsifiable assertion about what the code does.

location.description: file:line or region the claim was extracted from.

fetched.description: True only if this URL/DOI was retrieved in-session.

abstract_only.description: True if only the abstract (not full text) was available.

downgraded.description: True if the refutation pass downgraded the verdict to UNCONFIRMED.

refutation.description: Outcome of the adversarial refutation pass. verdicts[i] is true when refuter i refuted (a refuter that returned nothing is recorded as true).

allOf.comment: Grounding invariant: VIOLATION/DEVIATION require at least one fetched citation.
Refutation rule: a surviving VIOLATION/DEVIATION records its refutation votes (verdict-rubric.md step 4). The vote-count rule itself is enforced by report_lint.py.
